name: Rocket
summary: Ready to leave, with a window onto space.
text:
Three round windows: the largest shows space painted by hand — stars, planets — and the other two fill with light. The fins are dark and rest on the floor.

One of the tallest pieces, and one of the most asked for by children who have started looking up.

options.name: Power
options.help: Batteries are not included. The mains version comes with a remote: on, off, dimmer, timer and a slow pulse.

options.name: Laser engraving
options.help: A name, a date or a short phrase, burned into the wood. Leave it empty if you would rather not.
